measurement_notes.pdf_processing: Each PDF is opened with PyMuPDF and rendered one page at a time at the configured DPI before being passed to the shared PaddleOCR engine.
measurement_notes.cpu_time_definition: Process user + system CPU time measured during each OCR attempt. Because OCR slots run concurrently inside one process, this process-level CPU time can include activity from other concurrent slots.
measurement_notes.cpu_cores_used_definition: CPU seconds divided by wall-clock seconds for an OCR attempt. This is a process-level measurement and is not an exclusive per-thread CPU measurement.
measurement_notes.cpu_machine_capacity_definition: CPU cores used divided by logical CPU count multiplied by 100.
measurement_notes.peak_rss_definition: Lifetime maximum RSS of the single benchmark process.
measurement_notes.memory_cleanup_definition: Page-level PyMuPDF and NumPy references are released after each page and Python garbage collection is requested. Native Paddle/PaddleOCR allocators may retain memory.
measurement_notes.retry_definition: Failed OCR attempts are retried with exponential backoff.
measurement_notes.engine_sharing_definition: All benchmark concurrency slots run inside the same Python process and use exactly one cached benchmark PaddleOCR engine. OCR_ENGINE_LOCK serializes calls to the shared engine.
measurement_notes.memory_safety_definition: The benchmark intentionally disables document orientation classification, document unwarping, and textline orientation so that only the normal OCR detection and recognition models are initialized.
